description: Please note that this is the backup version of the BI Book Planning visual. You may find the latest version here https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/greenstep1681667712528.bibook-planning?tab=Overview The BI Book Planning visual enhances Power BI reporting by enabling users to input, edit, and update data directly within the platform. This feature allows for real-time financial planning, where forecasts and budgets can be adjusted instantly. It streamlines collaboration by allowing team members to update figures in a single report and supports scenario modeling for “what-if” analyses without altering the main dataset. This visual provides its users with accuracy through real-time updates, efficiency by simplifying processes, and informed decision-making with immediate access to data. Activation of BI Book Planning requires an existing BI Book environment. Monthly fees apply for the use of BI Book Planning. For more information please visit https://get.bibook.com/pricing
